aggregation by company/engine/provider with exact micro-euro Number round-trip guard

integrity_limit: SHA-256 chain is corruption/inconsistency detection, not authenticated tamper-proofing.
payload_limit: Platform objects, accessor properties and cycles are rejected instead of being executed or silently degraded by V8 serialization.
cost_limit: Numeric EUR inputs above the reliable micro-euro resolution bound are rejected before scaling. Binary floating-point noise around an integer micro-euro is tolerated using a magnitude/ULP-aware bound capped at 0.125 micro-euro; aggregates that cannot round-trip exactly from integer micro-euros to Number EUR are rejected. V0 does not claim arbitrary-size decimal money support.
migration: NONE. Parallel adapter only until OLD-vs-NEW comparison and explicit promotion gates.
